notes.title: The Dark Cave is available now!
notes.content:
[i]How far will you make it?[/i]

Hello Explorers!
The day has finally come, and my first game has been released. I can’t hold the excitement anymore.

I have been working on The Dark Cave for almost a year now, and it feels unreal to be pushing the “Release” button. The idea of developing this game started in an afternoon of boredom, but soon, the thought came to the forefront of my mind, and I decided to give birth to this project. It’s a challenge for me to develop this game by myself, as a solodev, but I’m a person who likes challenges and decided to develop the game using Godot - it’s also my first time using this engine!

As an avid strategy gamer, I’ve taken inspiration from masterpieces such as Slay the Spire or Shogun Showdown. I hope The Dark Cave can give you the same sense of greatness as my inspirations.
The action in The Dark Cave takes place on a board consisting of two 3x3 grids. Not only you’re limited by the space, but also by a certain amount of movements before your enemies strike. I wanted this game to spark creativity but also to be challenging, that’s why I decided to create a wide range of weapons and abilities, but restrain the gameplay in a way that will force you to squeeze your brains.

[previewyoutube=-G-b8N_46qI;full][/previewyoutube]

Please, enjoy this game and let me know if you liked it. This means the world to me.
If you encounter any bugs or troubles or just want to share your opinions, use the Steam forums or join 2P Game’s [url=2pgames.net/discord]Discord[/url] server. [u](On Strategy Games Group)[/u]


Thank you all for your support,
Leaves Games & 2P Games

notes.title: Inventive grid-based roguelike sets Steam launch, you can try it now
notes.content:
Steam has so many roguelikes these days that it's nigh impossible to cut through the noise. Procedural generation and permadeath mechanics are everywhere, but there's still a place for old-school, grid-based, roguelike action. With a newly announced release date that's just over the horizon, The Dark Cave looks like the perfect answer to the ever-expanding genre. Sometimes simpler is better.

notes.title: The Dark Cave is coming!
notes.content:
Dear adventurer,

Every move you made counts! We are excited to announce that The Dark Cave, a pixel art turn-based strategy, deck-building roguelike, will release on Steam for $4.99 / €4.99, with a two weeks launch discount of 15% at 8:00 PM on July 15(PDT). You will have to make calculated decisions and carefully plan your movements as you combat in two 3x3 grids, with limited movement and a wide array of weapons and abilities. Remember, every move is crucial and there aren't any easy decisions to make while in the dark cave!

The Dark Cave offers a unique experience in every run, thanks to the combination of characters and abilities plus 20+ enhancement effects (that have a permanent effect, even with different characters), 20+ potions (disposable but with an immediate effect), and 40+ relics (they give you a buff only for the current run). Choose your combat style carefully to reach the innermost rooms of the cave!
